scenarios.title: Studio landing hero

requests.prompt: Create a polished landing hero for Northstar Studio: heading “Ideas made clear”, one concise description, and a “See our work” link to #work. Use a self-contained abstract visual made with CSS. Do not fetch remote images.

criteria: The requested content is complete and readable.
The page is usable with keyboard and at the chosen guide size.
No unavailable service, invented claim or asset is presented as working.
